value.rationale: The exact Fourier-extension norm over cyclic local rings is a central quantitative question in ring restriction theory: nilpotent fibers produce a sharp alternating prime-adic dependence (p^m at even k versus (2-1/p)p^m at odd k). The complete equality geometry exhibits strict coset concentration and an exceptional p-way phase freedom, giving natural sharp families of test cases for restriction and concentration estimates. The result is uniform across every odd prime and all prime-power depths, beyond table recomputation or an obvious field specialization.
